newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU postpones decision on Greek maize export tender.
newsitem.headline: EU postpones decision on Greek maize export tender.

text.p: The European Union's grain committee on Thursday postponed a decision to open a tender for the export of 100,000 tonnes of Greek maize, grain industry sources said on Friday.
Discussion of the measure was on the agenda of the EU's grain panel but it was postponed to allow for fine-tuning of legal details.

The measure, if agreed, would provide an outlet for excess maize production in northeastern Greece and thus avoid sales to intervention stores. Potential markets for Greek maize include Bulgaria and Turkey.
